name: EAMCEF Grants

funder.name: Eastern Arc Mountain Conservation Endowment Fund (EAMCEF)

summary: Micro, medium and multi-year grants from a Tanzanian endowment fund for conservation and community projects in the Eastern Arc Mountains, with a yearly call for community development and climate adaptation grants.

eligibility.rule: NGOs and community groups work with local communities
Community groups have 5+ members recognized by the village government
NGOs registered at least 2 years before applying
Projects with foreign partners request support only for the Tanzanian portion

co_finance.applies_to: forest conservation and community development projects

documents: Authorized Organizational Representative or individual applicant certification
Detailed, itemized budget for each year of support requested
Budget justification annex of no more than 5 pages
Reference information annex, for research proposals

calls.label: Annual community grants call (July)
calls.recurring: Call announced in July and proposals due in the last week of September each year, subject to funds.

status.quote: EAMCEF currently undertakes at most one call for proposals per year for community development and climate change adaptation grants, in July, contingent upon the availability of funds.

recurring.quote: July Announce call for proposals - use local media, newsletters, website, LACs, field officers, colleagues and others to distribute announcement September Last week of September proposals due in offices of EAMCEF

applicant_types.quote: Central Government Departments, District Councils, government agencies, NGOs, CBOs, Local Communities, Research Institutions, Academic Institutions and Individuals are all eligible for submitting Project Proposals.

access.quote: Before formal submission, the proposal may be discussed with appropriate EAMCEF Secretariat staff.

window.quote: EAMCEF currently undertakes at most one call for proposals per year for community development and climate change adaptation grants, in July, contingent upon the availability of funds.

amount.quote: Grants range from Tsh 10M to 100M per year (averaging Tsh 10M-50M).

geography.quote: EAMCEF considers proposals for cooperative projects involving Tanzanian and foreign organizations, provided the support is requested only for the Tanzanian portion of the collaborative effort.

co_finance_required.quote: All forest conservation and community development projects need to have some level of financial or in-kind input to complement the funding provided by EAMCEF.

consortium_required.quote: The Recipient can as well be the Implementer in cases where the management of the funds and the implementation of project activities are all vested into one and the same organization.

eligibility.quote: Eligible NGOs and local community groups must be those working with local communities.
A group of five or more people recognized by the village government is defined as a local community group in this context.
Any applying NGO must have been registered at least 2 years before the proposing date.
EAMCEF considers proposals for cooperative projects involving Tanzanian and foreign organizations, provided the support is requested only for the Tanzanian portion of the collaborative effort.

co_finance.quote: The level of contribution depends on the type of submission and project that is proposed, but at a minimum should equal at least 5% of the total project costs.

documents.quote: All project applicants must complete the cover sheet and provide the information required in the proposal.

Certification for Authorized Organizational Representative (AOR) or Individual Applicant The AOR is required to complete certifications regarding the accuracy and completeness of statements contained in the proposal, as well as to certify that the organization (or individual) agree to accept the obligation to comply with award terms and conditions. · Certification Regarding Conflict of Interest
The proposal must contain a detailed, itemized budget for each year of support requested.
A detailed budget justification should appear in a separate annex. The annex should include a budget justification of no more than 5 pages to justify the budget numbers provided in this section.
For all research proposals, reference information is required and should appear in an annex.

effort.quote: Last week of September proposals due in offices of EAMCEF
Review processes completed and projects selected and ranked for funding
Board meets and reaches funding decision regarding projects

after_award.quote: Discrete/Medium Grants - Projects approved for one to three years submit an end of the 1stand 2nd tranche funds reports, giving technical and financial details and a final report at the conclusion of the project.
Undertaking of a field visit in which EAMCEF monitoring staff will be able to verify what have actually been undertaken in the implementation of the planned activities.
